goal: Integration operator can execute only documented XianGuanJia read requests through a canonical signed transport boundary.
non_goals: Do not add a third-party write operation, write-capable endpoint, or real API call.
Do not persist channel data, advance cursors, or return webhook success before durable persistence exists.
Do not place credentials, signatures, private recipient fields, or customer data in source, logs, fixtures, or responses.
expected_evidence: Focused signer, webhook verifier, redactor, and error-classification tests
Maven module test output and no-write-path scan
unsafe_assumptions: The account uses self-developed application signing; business seller_id signing remains disabled until explicitly confirmed.
Official documents do not publish a complete retry/error-code policy, so remote business errors must not be retried automatically.
stop_condition: Stop if an endpoint is not present in the 2026-07-23 official Markdown, a write operation is needed, or the task would edit outside the scope lock.
